About Organization

The Himachal Pradesh High Court is the highest court in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It was established on 25 January 1971.

The court is located in Shimla, the capital city of Himachal Pradesh.

About the Programme

The Himachal Pradesh High Court Various Post Recruitment 2026 is a government job recruitment program aimed at filling various vacancies in the High Court of Himachal Pradesh.

The program is open to Indian citizens who meet the eligibility criteria.
